column1: # House romanization "house/1" for planet/language/romanize.py (builder A, 2026-11-03). Deterministic, ASCII first,
# digraphs next, diacritics last. Base sounds only: modifiers are composed in romanize.py (aspiration h, ejective ', labialized w,
# palatalized y (Hepburn ky, ny), prenasal m/n/ng before, voiceless sonorant h before, long consonant = first letter doubled (Hungarian ssz),
# long vowel = last letter doubled, nasal vowel = tilde, tone: Yoruba-style acute high / grave low / mid unmarked, caron rising,
# circumflex falling, double acute extra-high, double grave extra-low). Non-human percepts keep their symbols.tsv marks.
# alt = the spelling used when the lect writes aspiration (it contrasts aspirated and plain): th, dh, kh, gh, sh, zh, ch, qh
# would then read as aspirates, so the fricatives take their single-letter forms. Velar and uvular never share a spelling.
# convention = the real orthography or transliteration followed ("house" = coined here; "merge" = a documented merger).
